preamble: Middle Chinese [dʒ] (崇 initial, Baxter dzr-) gave the fricative [ʂ] in Mandarin in the 止 rime class (士 事 仕 柿 shì), whereas outside that class oblique-tone dzr- words regularly gave the affricate [ʈʂ] (助 zhù, 狀 zhuàng, 驟 zhòu, 棧 zhàn, 寨 zhài; see j_affricate_to_ch_retroflex). The phonetic value of this initial is disputed: Zhengzhang Shangfang reconstructs the 莊 series as postalveolar [tʃ tʃʰ dʒ ʃ], which is the value used here, while Karlgren, Pulleyblank and Pan Wuyun reconstruct retroflex [ɖʐ].
